governingDecisions: Travel/TinySkies remains the macro world and renderer owner.
World Builder edits the same running world; it is not a detached editor scene.
Authoring and locomotion are separate axes: PLAY|BUILD|GOD versus GROUND|FLIGHT|DRIVE.
BlockBits/Voxel is a local construction and terraforming tool, not the replacement world aesthetic.
PLAY and BUILD consume the same persistent World Recipe.
Asset Registry/Librarian remains read-only source/discovery owner; Builder consumes candidate bundles.
Source assets are never silently edited; scale/look corrections live as explicit calibration overrides.
No Town content expansion until the WB0 human-browser gate passes.

cleanRoomDonor.license: All rights reserved. Observation-only donor. Do not copy, port, modify or derive code/assets/data tables without permission.
observations: Compact authored route skeleton → derive dense road geometry, banking, hills, racing line, cues and gameplay markings.
Route metadata is a reference, not a cage: vehicles still simulate in world coordinates.
Correlated spatial fields create districts/ridges better than per-object random noise.
A zone can use one dominant shape language/palette plus limited secondary variation.
Procedural SFX/ambience can be a coherent glue layer while hero music remains authored/Suno-based.
Seeded music/world candidates become useful when paired with a human seed browser/curation step.
Bake/compile stable world results once; rebuild only affected authoring state when the recipe changes.
Canonical assets provide identity; procedural geometry can provide connective tissue.
forbidden: No copied source code or algorithms line-for-line.
No copied constants, circuit data, seed tables, music parameter tables or shape implementations.
No claim that SP13KTRA code is a permissible implementation donor.
Independent KFB implementations must be written from KFB requirements and our own contracts.
